sql.query: SELECT t.id,CAST(t.isActive=1 AND t.lifecycleStatus='active' AND (t.accessStartDate IS NULL OR t.accessStartDate<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (t.accessEndDate IS NULL OR t.accessEndDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS UNSIGNED) canWrite FROM tbl_tenants t WHERE t.id=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants ut WHERE ut.tenantId=t.id AND ut.userId=:userId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active') LIMIT 1
